chapter: Floods, Mardi Gras and street music
title: Street instruments at Mardi Gras
summary: Young people used tin plates, spoons and washboards in the street.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: Were there many instruments out in the street? Any bands that you remember? No.

If they had bands it was young people you know. Some had tin plates and spoons. They'd hit on that band. Some had washboard and they'd make music with that. What would they hit the washboard with? Well I don't know what they'd do but they'd have the washboard and they'd run the hand like this on it you know. And make music.
